MeadowPath_Text_Npc0.en: Good spot to meet every early\nPOKéMON.
MeadowPath_Text_Npc0.fr: Bon endroit pour rencontrer tous\nles premiers POKéMON.

MeadowPath_Text_Npc1.en: Both NIDORAN live here. Catch a\npair!
MeadowPath_Text_Npc1.fr: Les deux NIDORAN vivent ici.\nAttrape la paire !

MeadowPath_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: My POKéMON are hurt. Two POTIONs\nfor an EXP SHARE?
MeadowPath_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Mes POKéMON sont blessés. Deux\nPOTIONS contre un PARTAGE EXP. ?

MeadowPath_Text_Quest0_Done.en: You saved us! Take this EXP SHARE.
MeadowPath_Text_Quest0_Done.fr: Tu nous as sauvés ! Prends ce\nPARTAGE EXP.

MeadowPath_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
MeadowPath_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

MeadowPath_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

MeadowPath_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.

MeadowPath_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
MeadowPath_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Y a un truc qui brille ici, mais\nton SAC est plein.
